pending: Confirm wall geometry, cover, mix, exposure/coating, pile tolerance and governing FDOT/project criteria. C006 dimensions are a study snapshot; current cap uses 3-in pile tolerance.
Gravity/self-weight only. Confirm cap isolation, lateral wind/impact/water/soil, construction, seismic, shrinkage and all applicable combinations.
Mid-height tributary boundaries are an assumed strength load allocation, not a stiffness/contact solution. Establish compatibility and a credible reaction envelope for all ring rows.
Resolve actual front/back struts around the hollow pipe, active annular contact, splitting, spalling, breakout/punching and group/edge effects. No assumed concrete cone is a support.
Develop an end-strip STM or local continuum model carrying the reported cantilever moment and shear into each outer ring. The bay arch does not solve the overhang.

Anchor dedicated horizontal ties and collectors at the actual extended nodes; check lower-wall suspension, U-bar laps, bend bearing, congestion and transverse confinement. Available node development is not yet established.
Complete weld group including radial plate-root moment/prying, ring split splices, fatigue if applicable, pile-shell local bending/ovalization, effective corrosion thickness and global pile actions.
Resolve ring/grid clashes and end cover at pile tolerance; detail through-thickness ties around the pipe and access for concrete placement/welding.
